title: AI Worldbuilding Studio
intro: Build from a world blueprint. Templates, entities, sources and links belong to this work. AI produces proposals; the author decides.
stepTemplates: Choose or compose templates with fields specific to your work.
stepDesign: Define the goal and selected sources, then request bounded AI proposals.
stepReview: Edit and adopt entries individually. Release a safe Writer summary when appropriate.
completenessHint: Counts filled fields only; it does not measure quality or mathematical feasibility.
templateCompatibility: Keep existing field IDs, types and options. Updates create a new version. Saved entries retain their original template snapshot and content.
visibleWhen: Visibility condition (sibling field ID and matching value)
customTemplateHint: Add guidance and custom fields or compose existing modules.
imported: Template imported. No world settings or manuscript content included.
invalidJSON: Invalid JSON. Correct it before saving.
saveFirst: Save or discard candidate edits first.
goal: What world or setting would you like to build?
sourceScope: Only checked entries are sent, up to eight. The entire encyclopedia is never read automatically. Check for private or hidden information first.
boundedHint: At most four candidates per batch; only manually started batches run. Completed results survive cancellation. Costs depend on the chosen model and provider.
candidateHint: Save the goal and templates, then select a model and explicitly start one batch. Existing drafts can be reopened from history.
sendConsent: I reviewed the scope and authorize sending this goal, selected sources and current template to the selected model. One request may incur charges.
formalConfirm: Adopt this AI entry as a formal setting in this work? Manuscript, State, Knowledge and committed Timeline remain unchanged. Check the content and missing conditions first.
relationHint: These links are suggestions. Adopt the entries, then review and create links in the existing encyclopedia Links tab.
historyHint: Completed batches are saved independently. Restarting never restarts AI requests; choose a batch to continue.
noDesign: No design drafts yet. Start with a country, city or organization.
basis_AUTHOR_INPUT: Author input (model label; verify before adoption)
view_missing: Empty fields eligible for AI suggestions
authorOnly: Author-only field; AI cannot fill it automatically.
writerReleaseHint: Only author-confirmed summaries in formal entries can be selected for writing. Raw fields, secrets and full entries are never sent automatically. This does not replace committed character Knowledge State.
writerPublic: Summary is public to all POVs
upgradeConfirm: Upgrade the entry template? Existing values remain and new fields stay unknown.
continueAnswers: Create a follow-up draft using answers on the left
existingRevisionHint: The candidate is below. Unspecified fields remain. Only explicit author adoption changes the existing entry; locks still apply.
sourceHint: Sources retain their original revision. Stale quotations do not prove current settings. Model labels and interpretations need author review.
noSources: No manuscript source is bound. Author input and AI proposals are not committed story evidence.
useBlueprint: Include this world blueprint as author planning, not confirmed Canon
starterTitle: Start with an AI worldbuilding draft
starterHint: Describe the world. Characters, plot, literary themes and a completed blueprint are not required. Prepare the draft, then choose a model and confirm generation.
starterBoundedHint: Generate one world overview to edit and adopt. Switch to detailed design later for countries, places or institutions.
